revision: G: stock-tube core corner and frame candidate
status: Dimensioned candidate; strength screening only, not fabrication or flight release

material.name: 6061-T6 aluminum; verify grade and temper of supplied stock
material.note: 120/80 MPa are project screening limits, not certified design allowables. E is a declared engineering approximation. Hydro lists 240 MPa minimum yield for its 6061-T6 extrusions.

corner.note: Cut four short sections; the tube ends remain open for outward-moving steel sliders. No longitudinal slot or milling is needed in the tube. Corner radii and stock tolerances must be checked.

loads.note: 600 N is inherited from SYSTEM_DESIGN section 4; do not multiply it by another acceleration factor. Two anchors sharing it is an unequal-load case, not permission to fly with two unlocked joints.

layout.note: 15% internal reserve is a packaging assumption, not tested usable capacity. Preserve target capacities and contents; verify inlet, baffles, seals and evacuation space later.

fabrication_tools: stock cut to length by supplier or metal-cutting saw
